headline: Gulf diesel exports to the world fell after the war began
subhead: Diesel and gas oil, thousand barrels per day, average of Sep 2025–Feb 2026 vs Apr–Jun 2026
note: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Bahrain are the only Gulf states that report diesel exports. EU27 and Australia count imports from all eight Gulf states (incl. UAE, Qatar, Oman, Iraq and Iran). March 2026 is left out: the war began on 28 February.
source: JODI Oil World Database (gas/diesel oil exports); Eurostat Comext, CN 27101943/44/46/47/48; Australian Petroleum Statistics (diesel imports by country)
